responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_ast_pretty/src/pp/convenience.rs: Provides the `Printer` convenience API for constructing pretty-printing token streams in the `pp` module. This file exposes higher-level operations for opening and closing boxes, inserting spaces and hard breaks, emitting words and trailing commas, checking beginning-of-line state, and creating hard-break tokens, all by translating ergonomic formatting calls into the lower-level scan/token primitives used by the pretty-printer core. compiler/rustc_ast_pretty/src/pp/ring.rs: Defines the `RingBuffer` utility used by the pretty-printer to store a sliding window of items addressed by monotonically increasing abstract indices. It owns the deque-backed buffer state, tracks the logical offset of the first element, and provides indexed, front/back, push, pop, and clear operations so the printer can manage token or scan data as an infinite queue view over a finite retained range.
